note: Original practice prompts written for Bo-ok in the style of IELTS Academic Writing. Task 1 data is invented practice data.

prompts.text: Some people believe that online courses will soon replace traditional classroom teaching at universities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Private cars should be banned from city centres. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view?
Some people think that adult children should look after their elderly parents at home, while others believe the government should provide care. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some say that governments should spend money on professional sports teams, while others argue it should be spent on sport facilities for ordinary people. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many countries, young people find it difficult to get their first job. What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
The amount of plastic waste is increasing every year. Why is this happening, and what measures could be taken to reduce it?
More and more people are choosing to work in a country other than their own. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
Many children now have their own smartphone before the age of ten. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Museums and art galleries should be free for everyone to visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
News reports in the media mostly focus on negative events. Why do you think this is the case? What effects does this have on people?
Many people are leaving villages to live in large cities. What problems does this cause, and how could they be solved?

Some believe that exams are the best way to measure what students have learned, while others think continuous assessment through projects and coursework is better. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

The line graph shows the percentage of commuters who travelled to work by bicycle, bus and car in one city between 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
The bar chart shows the sources of electricity in one country in 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
prompts.data: Practice data (percentage of electricity): Coal — 2005: 48, 2025: 15. Gas — 2005: 30, 2025: 28. Wind — 2005: 2, 2025: 24. Solar — 2005: 0, 2025: 18. Nuclear — 2005: 20, 2025: 15.

prompts.text: The table shows the number of visits to a public library, by type of use, in 2010 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
prompts.data: Practice data (visits per year, thousands): Borrowing books — 2010: 120, 2024: 70. Using computers — 2010: 40, 2024: 25. Study space — 2010: 35, 2024: 90. Events and classes — 2010: 10, 2024: 45.

prompts.text: The information below describes how coffee is produced, from harvest to packaging. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
prompts.data: Practice process: 1) ripe coffee cherries are picked by hand; 2) the cherries are washed and the outer fruit is removed; 3) the beans are left to ferment for 1–2 days; 4) they are dried in the sun for about two weeks; 5) the dry outer skin is removed by machine; 6) the beans are sorted by size and roasted at about 200°C; 7) they are cooled, ground (or left whole) and packed in airtight bags.
